label: Independent record
description: Independent official record - a filing, docket, or regulator document that states the fact directly.

label: Primary channel
description: Primary reporting channel for this trigger (e.g. a press wire or SEC filing) rather than an independent record.

label: Vendor/market
description: Vendor, market, or aggregated-signal source - weakest evidence tier; corroborate before acting.

label: Primary source
description: Fact sourced from a primary source (e.g. the vendor's own licensing page or an official filing).

label: Non-primary source
description: Fact sourced from a non-primary source - shown for context only; price details are never surfaced (R4.3).

label: Account
description: Signal is tied to a specific watchlist account.

label: Sector
description: Sector-wide signal with no single account - applies broadly across the subsector.

label: Regulatory calendar
description: Regulatory compliance-clock signal (rulemaking / directive) affecting the sector.
